note: Poli (Treasure) (slug `poli`) — Elysion Water SG DEFENDER, Burst II, 40s burst CD, ammo 9 / hitsPerShot 10 pellets / reloadFrames 111 / normalMult 201.5 (datamine). FROM-SCRATCH kit-autonomy build 2026-08-03 (no prior override; simSupported was false). A tank-enabler whose only offensive lines are two team ATK auras; everything else is shield/DEF/sustain (event-only or inert in v1). S1 'Activates after 5 normal attacks → all allies ATK ▲5.46%/10s' = hitCount:50 → allies → atkPct 5.46/10s. 'NORMAL ATTACKS' ON AN SG = TRIGGER PULLS per the repo SG convention (guilty's 'every 6 normal attacks' = hitCount:60 precedent): the engine's hit counter advances by hitsPerShot (10 pellets) per pull, so 5 attacks = count 50 = one proc every 5 pulls (~3.3s at the SG 1.5-pulls/s class rate ⇒ the 10s window saturates to ~100% uptime after the first proc at shot 5). S1 'Activates at the start of battle → self: Police Badge — Shield = 100% of final Max HP for 10s' = passive → self → shield{maxHpPct:100, durationSec:10}: an EVENT-only shield (no HP pool at scope — tia/blanc precedent) that fires poli's own 'shielded' triggers and opens her requiresShielded window for 10s from frame 0. The badge's two in-kit ROLES are the burst's Indomitability gate and the S2 badge-end heal anchor — both unmodeled (see below), so in damage terms the badge is inert kit-completeness + shield-synergy wiring. S2 'every 20s → self and 2 lowest-HP allies: DEF ▲23.51%/10s' = TWO interval:20 blocks (self + alliesLowestHp count 2 excludeSelf), defPct 23.51/10s each — damage-INERT in v1 (self/team DEF never feeds damage dealt), encoded for kit completeness (crust/novel defPct precedent); 'lowest remaining HP' is the engine's deterministic leftmost stand-in (no HP pool). S2 'Equally shares damage taken for 10s' = UNMODELED (no damage-redistribution primitive; defensive — the v1 boss deals no damage). S2 'when Police Badge ends → recovers 5% final Max HP every 1s for 5s' = UNMODELED ⚑1 (expressible at scope as battleStart + block delaySec:10 — the badge end is deterministic and no first-class shield-expiry trigger exists; the heal amount is inert without an HP pool, and the line is SELF-targeted, so its recovery events would fire only the recipient's — poli's — on-recovery blocks and cannot feed a Crown-type consumer on a teammate). BURST 'when in Police Badge status → Indomitability 5s, removes Police Badge' = UNMODELED (blanc Indomitability precedent; no self-status gate either — and the gate is unsatisfied in practice at scope lock: the badge expires at t=10s while her first burst cast waits on the first full-burst chain, which typically lands past 10s (burst CDs start ready; the 40s CD gates only casts after her first)). BURST 'shared Shield = 40% of final Max HP protecting all allies for 10s' = burstCast → allies → shield{maxHpPct:40, durationSec:10}: event-only, fires every ally's 'shielded' trigger per cast (shield-synergy wiring, tia precedent) ⚑2 VALUE DISAGREEMENT: the blablalink prose says 40% but the datamine description_value_list in the same file carries 22.27% at level 10 — shipped at the prose value; magnitude is unobservable in v1 either way (no HP pool). BURST 'all allies ATK ▲44.55%/10s' = burstCast → allies → atkPct 44.55/10s — her headline damage line; lands frame-exact on her stage-2 cast BEFORE the FB window opens (crust/novel burst-aura convention; fullBurstEnter would mis-time it behind the stage-3 completion). Burst gauge: no row in data/gauge-per-shot.json — the SG modal fallback (400 energy/trigger = 4%/shot) EXACTLY matches her datamined burstGaugePerShot 2 (bgps×200 mapping; neve precedent for row-less simSupported units), and her kit carries no gauge line, so flatPerTrigger 0 is faithful. ⚑1 BADGE-END RECOVERY: estimate = 5 recovery events over t≈10-14s, once per battle (badge is battle-start only); recipe = engine would need a shield-expired trigger primitive; until then, size it only if a poli+crown recording shows crown's recovery buff firing at ~10-15s; Tier 2 if ever material. ⚑2 SHARED-SHIELD MAGNITUDE 40% (prose) vs 22.27% (datamine level-10 description value): inert at scope; recipe = read her burst shield HP popup from a focus video; Tier 1. ⚑3 CADENCE TUPLE (datamine, not focus-verified): SG class rate 1.5 pulls/s + reloadFrames 111; drives the S1 proc cadence (~3.3s) — recipe: rounds/min + reload gap from any poli focus video; Tier 1. Tier 1 overall: plain buff/interval/shield encodings, all on established precedents (guilty SG hitCount convention, novel interval cadence, tia shield-event + probe testability, blanc Indomitability skip, crust inert-defPct completeness); no scoped buffs, no round counts, no modeled status gate, not meta-defining. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-03: encoding authored test-first (scripts/tests/units/poli.test.ts) — every FAITHFUL line pinned GREEN vs this override and RED vs its nearest-wrong counterfactual.

kitDescription: Team-shield defender. Every 5 shotgun blasts she raises the whole team's ATK by 5.46% for 10s (near-permanent uptime); at battle start she gains the Police Badge, a self-shield equal to her full Max HP for 10s. Every 20s she raises her own DEF and that of the 2 most wounded allies by 23.51% for 10s and shares damage taken (defensive, unmodeled). Her burst grants all allies ATK ▲44.55% for 10s and a shared shield equal to 40% of her final Max HP for 10s; the badge-gated Indomitability and the badge-ending heal are unmodeled (defensive/no primitive).
